hypothesis: A smoothed conditional frequency by the sign of the last one-month unemployment change improves the two-month rise-event Brier over unconditional frequency, without shifting historical changes by extrapolated momentum.
analogue_signal: sign(rate_at_pair_start - rate_at_pair_start_minus_one_month), never uses the pair end
missing_policy: no imputation; unavailable current signal excludes origin for all compared methods; missing analogue signal omits only that analogue from conditional pool; all observed endpoint pairs define baseline
acceptance: paired candidate Brier at least 5 percent below frequency Brier and strictly below persistence p=0; success warrants a separate future protocol, never automatic issuance
retuning: none; one candidate, one strength, one signal, no search or rescue after scores
